# Commercial Readiness Report Template

> **NOT RELEASE EVIDENCE**

The authoritative report is an ignored local output uploaded by GitHub Actions.
It must bind the exact repository, Commit, Tree, Version, Migration, Workflow
Run, Run attempt, branch/Tag, all three image Digests, and the complete
machine-evaluated Gate table.

Tracked documents describe the contract and current blockers only. They do not
contain a self-referential HEAD field and cannot approve an external Gate.
